notes: Gallery French-door bottom-freezer with through-the-door ice and water, covering FFHB2750TD3, FFHB2750TE3, FFHB2750TP3 and FFHB2750TS3. Available on the market from 2017-04-03.

gaps: The catalogue gives part numbers and names only, no ratings except where noted (115 V on the cover, the 115 V solenoid and the 115 V ice maker).
The compressor maker and fan-motor ratings are not claimed.

Other functional parts in the catalogue not claimed below: complete ice maker 243297606 (115 V), ice-maker evaporator 242094701 and its defrost heater with safety thermostat 242094804, auger motor 241816602 (no voltage given), dispenser heater kit 5303918596, flipper mullion assembly with heater ...
method: Main source: Frigidaire Factory Parts Catalog, publication no. 5995694618 (dated 12/17, replaces 5995694352), covering FFHB2750TD3, FFHB2750TE3, FFHB2750TP3 and FFHB2750TS3, all 115 V; read as text from the PDF on 2026-11-12.
The PDF is an Internet Archive copy of a Manuals+ upload; no copy on a Frigidaire domain was found.
Retailer listings that might name the OEM compressor and fan-motor voltages (PartSelect, Sears PartsDirect, HD Supply, Frigidaire Appliance Parts, AppliancePartsPros) all returned HTTP 403.
The cooling-system page lists an 'Invertor' 241577505 right after the compressor.
ENERGY STAR lists FFHB2750T* at 715 kWh/yr, 26.9 cu ft total volume, with ice maker.
